svg.aria-label: Self-RAG: decide retrieval, grade relevance, check support and usefulness, revise or rewrite.
svg.title: Self-RAG: decide retrieval, grade relevance, check support and usefulness, revise or rewrite.

g.text: A · no retrieval needed → answer directly
B · not fully supported → revise until grounded
C · not useful → rewrite query, retrieve again
pydantic judgements · bounded retries + revisions, so it always halts
Decides whether to retrieve, grades each
chunk, checks that its answer is grounded and
useful, and rewrites the query when it is not.
